## GWebAppAnswerResult type

Result of `TemplateManager.getGWebAppAnswer` for a `<g-web-app-answer>` block.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type GWebAppAnswerResult = {
    kind: `webAppAnswer`;
    text: string;
};
```

## Remarks

`text` is the marker text; the getter throws when neither the dedicated block nor the legacy `<g-answer-note>` alias is present.
